args.title: Fix timeout issue on totals endpoint for large reports
args.body:
File: src/routes/reports/totals.js

The totals endpoint takes too long to respond for large reports, causing timeouts. To improve performance, we will optimize the query to fetch only the necessary aggregate totals, reducing memory usage and request time.
